summary.goal: REST API for run management, monitoring, and real-time updates. Primary interface for Forge UI and external integrations. Gate approval endpoints are defined in forge-gate-handling.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /runs - create run from ForgePlan, starts task scheduling, returns run_id
GET /runs - list runs with status filter and pagination
GET /runs/:id - get run details including all tasks and their states
POST /runs/:id/pause - pause run (no new tasks started)
POST /runs/:id/resume - resume paused run
POST /runs/:id/cancel - cancel run (terminate active agents)
GET /runs/:id/tasks/:taskId - task details with attempts and artifacts
GET /runs/:id/events (SSE) - real-time run updates
GET /health - service health check
GET /agents - list active agents (merged relay presence + DB state)

observations: SSE for real-time updates (not WebSocket - simpler)
Gate endpoints owned by forge-gate-handling feature
Question endpoints owned by forge-question-queue feature
Pagination for runs list (could have many)

architect.auth: TBD - start with API key, add OAuth later

steps.title: Create API request/response schemas
steps.description: Define Zod schemas for API request validation and response types

acceptance_criteria.description: CreateRunRequestSchema: { plan: ForgePlan } or { plan_id, plan_version } to fetch from Planner
ListRunsQuerySchema: { status?, limit?, offset? }
RunResponseSchema: { run_id, plan_id, plan_version, status, has_pending_gate, tasks_count, tasks_completed, created_at }
Export TypeScript types from schemas

specification.pattern_description: Copy Zod schema validation pattern from planner-core API handlers

steps.title: Create run management handlers
steps.description: HTTP handlers for run CRUD operations

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /runs handler: validate ForgePlan, create Run + Tasks, start scheduler, return { run_id, status, tasks_count }
GET /runs handler: list with status filter, pagination, return [{ run_id, plan_id, status, created_at, tasks_count, tasks_completed }]
GET /runs/:id handler: full run with all tasks, return { run, tasks: [{ task_id, status, attempts_count }] }
Error responses match planner-core format: { error: string, code?: string }

specification.pattern_description: Copy handler pattern: createXxxHandlers(storage) returns object with handler functions

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /runs/:id/pause: set run status to 'paused', stop enqueueing new tasks
POST /runs/:id/resume: set run status to 'running', resume task scheduling
POST /runs/:id/cancel: set run status to 'cancelled', terminate active agents via spawner.terminate()
All return updated run object with new status

specification.pattern_description: Copy workflow handler pattern for state transitions

steps.title: Create task detail handlers
steps.description: HTTP handlers for task details and attempts

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /runs/:id/tasks/:taskId: return { task, attempts: [...], artifacts: [...] }
Attempts include: attempt_number, started_at, ended_at, outcome, error, audit_findings
Artifacts include: artifact_id, type, reference, metadata

specification.pattern_description: Similar pattern for nested resource retrieval

steps.title: Create SSE events handler
steps.description: Server-Sent Events for real-time run updates

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /runs/:id/events returns SSE stream
Events: run_status_changed, task_status_changed, gate_reached, agent_progress, question_added, question_answered
Event format: { event, data: JSON }
Heartbeat every 30s to keep connection alive
Support Last-Event-ID for reconnection

specification.pattern_description: Copy SSE handler pattern from planner-core events handler

steps.title: Create active agents handler
steps.description: HTTP handler for listing active agents

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /agents returns merged view of agent presence and task state
Response: [{ agent_id, run_id, task_id, status, last_heartbeat, current_task_title }]
Merges relay.listAgents() presence with storage task info
Optional filter by run_id

Middleware: cors, json body parser, request logging

steps.title: Implement run startup sequence
steps.description: When run is created, start the execution pipeline

acceptance_criteria.description: After creating Run + Tasks in DB, call scheduler.scheduleReadyTasks(runId)
Run status transitions from 'pending' to 'running'
Emit trajectory event 'run_started'
Return immediately after scheduling - execution is async

architecture.sequence: create run -> create tasks -> transition to running -> schedule ready tasks -> return
